notes.title: Check out our newest game: BIT.TRIP RERUNNER!
notes.content:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2222540/BITTRIP_RERUNNER/]BUY or WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM![/url][/h1]

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER features the RUNNER MAKER level editor tool, empowering players to craft their own challenging levels. Additionally, the game introduces the exciting MUSIC MAKER, enabling players to compose personalized soundtracks for their gameplay. This innovative feature adds a new layer of creativity, allowing players to shape both the visual and auditory aspects of their BIT.TRIP RUNNER experience.

[h2]The power of the MUSIC MAKER[/h2]
[previewyoutube=QceTOml2LvE;full][/previewyoutube]
[list]
[*] Brave 150+ obstacle-filled levels based on the classic games – each more challenging than the last.
[*] Dive head-first into a trippy new art style powered by Unreal 5.
[*] Enjoy a fully remixed soundtrack at unhealthy volume levels.
[*] Create and share the levels of your dreams with RUNNER MAKER.
[*] Uncover gaming artifacts in the Historical Gallery – with fun nods to the original game!
[/list]

[h2]Trailer! [/h2]
[previewyoutube=AsLm6H1W1m4;full][/previewyoutube]

“I have had an incredible time with BIT.TRIP RERUNNER. There is so much replayability here.”

9/10 – Rectify Gaming

notes.title: Dragon Fantasy: The Volumes of Westeria is available now!
notes.content:
Hey everybody!

Dragon Fantasy: The Volumes of Westeria is available now for PC, Mac, and Linux! Pick it up in the first week and get 10% off! 

For those who don't know, Dragon Fantasy: The Volumes of Westeria is the first game release from Choice Publishing, which is the new publishing arm of Choice Provisions. It's a retro-inspired RPG developed by the fine folks at Muteki. If you have any amount of nostalgia for the classic JRPGs of yore--or are just in the market for a good RPG--this is for you!

Please let us know if you have any questions or requests! We're always listening!

Enjoy!
